v_sbjv.name: Verb form after të or do të (subjunctive, future, conditional)

v_aor.name: Verb form after u (non-active aorist, optative, admirative)

v_ptcp.name: Participle after an auxiliary or duke, pa, për të

adj_f.name: Adjective, feminine singular (after e or së)

adj_pl.name: Adjective after the article të (plural or oblique)

transforms.name: s' (not)
transforms.description: The negation s' (nuk) written before a verb: s'kam → kam, s'di → di.

transforms.name: ç' (what)
transforms.description: The interrogative ç' (çfarë) written before a verb: ç'bën → bën → bëj.

transforms.name: definite (masculine) / indefinite oblique
transforms.description: Masculine singular: the definite nominative, or the indefinite genitive, dative or ablative (mal → mali, mik → miku, djalë → djali, libër → libri).

transforms.name: definite accusative (masculine)
transforms.description: Masculine singular definite accusative (mal → malin, mik → mikun, djalë → djalin, libër → librin, vëlla → vëllanë).

transforms.name: definite genitive/dative/ablative (masculine)
transforms.description: Masculine singular definite genitive, dative or ablative (mal → malit, mik → mikut, djalë → djalit, libër → librit).

transforms.name: definite (feminine)
transforms.description: Feminine singular definite nominative (vajzë → vajza, motër → motra, shtëpi → shtëpia, lule → lulja, pyetje → pyetja, kala → kalaja).

transforms.name: definite accusative (feminine)
transforms.description: Feminine singular definite accusative (vajzë → vajzën, lule → lulen, motër → motrën, shtëpi → shtëpinë, grua → gruan).

transforms.name: definite genitive/dative/ablative (feminine)
transforms.description: Feminine singular definite genitive, dative or ablative (vajzë → vajzës, lule → lules, motër → motrës, shtëpi → shtëpisë, grua → gruas).

transforms.name: indefinite genitive/dative/ablative (feminine)
transforms.description: Feminine singular indefinite genitive, dative or ablative (vajzë → vajze, motër → motre, shtëpi → shtëpie, lule → luleje).

transforms.name: definite plural
transforms.description: Plural definite nominative or accusative (male → malet, vajza → vajzat, miq → miqtë, shtëpi → shtëpitë, njerëz → njerëzit).

transforms.name: plural genitive/dative/ablative
transforms.description: Plural genitive, dative or ablative, definite or indefinite (male → maleve, vajza → vajzave, miq → miqve).

transforms.name: indefinite ablative plural
transforms.description: Plural indefinite ablative (male → malesh, vajza → vajzash, miq → miqsh, nxënës → nxënësish).

transforms.name: plural
transforms.description: Indefinite plural (mal → male, shok → shokë, gisht → gishta, vajzë → vajza, libër → libra, mik → miq, zog → zogj, lumë → lumenj, shembull → shembuj, fshat → fshatra, mbret → mbretër).

transforms.name: verbal noun (-im)
transforms.description: A verbal noun in -im read as its verb (bashkim → bashkoj, kthim → kthej, përkthim → përkthej).

transforms.name: ordinal
transforms.description: An ordinal number: i katërt, e katërta → katër (four); i pestë, e pesta → pesë (five).

transforms.name: future/conditional (do të)
transforms.description: do të before the subjunctive (future: do të punoj) or the imperfect (conditional: do të punoja); do ta and do t'i carry the pronoun e or i.

transforms.name: subjunctive (të)
transforms.description: të before the present or imperfect subjunctive (të punoj, të punosh, të punonte); ta and t'i carry the pronoun e or i.

transforms.name: infinitive (për të)

transforms.name: non-active (u)
transforms.description: u before the aorist, optative or admirative of the non-active (u bë, u largova, u bëfsha, u bëka).

transforms.name: non-active
transforms.description: A non-active form read as the mediopassive verb a dictionary lists (u largua → largohem, u ul → ulem, është kthyer → kthehem).

transforms.name: +e (it, him, her)
transforms.description: The pronoun e attached to an imperative (hape → hap, merre → merr, lexoje → lexo, shkruaje → shkruaj, hapeni → hapni).

transforms.name: +i (to him, her, them)
transforms.description: The pronoun i attached to an imperative (jepi → jep, tregoji → trego, thuaji → thuaj, jepini → jepni).

transforms.name: +më (me)
transforms.description: The pronoun më attached to an imperative (jepmë → jep, tregomë → trego, thuamë → thuaj).

transforms.name: +na (us)
transforms.description: The pronoun na attached to an imperative (jepna → jep, tregona → trego, falna → fal).

transforms.name: comparative (më)
transforms.description: The comparative or superlative më before an adjective or a gradable adverb: më i mirë → mirë, më shpejt → shpejt, më vonë → vonë.

transforms.name: adjective article (i/e/të/së)
transforms.description: The article an adjective takes: i mirë, e mirë, të mira, së madhe → mirë, madh.

transforms.name: feminine
transforms.description: Feminine singular, also the feminine plural of adjectives without an article (madh → madhe, keq → keqe, ndryshëm → ndryshme, shqiptar → shqiptare, zi → zezë).

transforms.name: feminine plural
transforms.description: Feminine plural (mirë → mira, bukur → bukura, vogël → vogla, vjetër → vjetra, madh → mëdha, ri → reja, keq → këqija, zi → zeza).

transforms.name: masculine plural
transforms.description: Masculine plural (shqiptar → shqiptarë, madh → mëdhenj, vogël → vegjël, ri → rinj, keq → këqij, zi → zinj); most articulated adjectives keep their singular (të mirë).

transforms.name: definite (masculine)
transforms.description: Masculine definite adjective (i miri, të mirin, të mirit → mirë; i madhi → madh; i riu → ri).

transforms.name: definite (feminine)
transforms.description: Feminine definite adjective (e mira, të mirën, të mirës → mirë; e madhja, të madhen → madh; e reja → ri).

transforms.name: definite plural
transforms.description: Plural definite adjective (të mirët, të mirat, të mirëve, të mirave → mirë; të mëdhenjtë → madh).
